scenario.title: Pack under-voltage applies while driving and not while parked -- limit = 60000, expected legal
scenario.description:
Walk the under-voltage limit across its boundary in both states. Parked, no value may raise a fault however low it goes. Driving, the limit itself is legal and the first value below it must fault with UNDERVOLT and latch.
Generated from pattern 'state-dependent-rule' by harness/expand.py.
This variant places limit at 60000, which is the mandatory legal member of the boundary of limit = 60000 under a strict comparison.
The expected outcome for this variant is legal.
